newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat down in low volume before trade dinner.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat down in low volume before trade dinner.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended lower in thin trade.

With many market players absent ahead of the Grain and Feed Trade Association annual dinner in London, the market was susceptible to being driven down, one trader said. But enough buyers came in to get prices off lows by the close.
Forecasts of much-needed rain in Europe's cereal growing areas contributed to the weakness on new crop, he said, but the old crop fall could not be put down to the same cause, he said.
July was most active on wheat, with 123 lots of a total 243. It last traded 1.15 stg lower at 99.50 stg. But July had seen a low of 98.90 stg earlier in the day.
Barley trade was limited to eight lots of May, which last traded 0.50 stg lower at 90.50 stg.
